summary: Renders a text-input widget's edit buffer: sets the active font (defaulting to the shared byte_5EA438 string when the font sub-object's path pointer is null), initializes the text-measurement context, resolves the layout/delegation child object and forwards the widget rectangle through a 10-argument layout call, then copies the edit buffer at this+0x2F0 into a scratch string, masking every character as '*' (0x2A) when the password flag at this+0xE2 is set, appending the cursor glyph word_5CC214 when both visibility flag this+0xE0 and cursor flag this+0xE1 are set, measuring the string, left-scrolling the render start pointer while the measured width exceeds the view width (vtable[+32] minus vtable[+24]), drawing via BitmapDraw_81f0 with the widget's vtable geometry, writing that geometry back to the four out parameters, and invoking the vtable[+44] post-render callback before returning 0.

local_names.this: text input widget; carries font sub-object, layout flags, text buffer and vtable geometry
local_names.a2: out parameter receiving the drawn text left position (vtable[+28])
local_names.a3: out parameter receiving the drawn text top position (vtable[+36])
local_names.a4: out parameter receiving the drawn text width (vtable[+24])
local_names.a5: out parameter receiving the drawn text height (vtable[+32])
local_names.v6: font sub-object pointer read at this+0xC8
local_names.v8: resolved font path string, defaulting to byte_5EA438
local_names.v9: layout/delegation child object returned by ConditionalDelegation_6460
local_names.v10: kept alias of the delegation child object
local_names.v12: pointer to the source edit buffer at this+0x2F0
local_names.v17: render start pointer advanced for left-scrolling on overflow
local_names.v32: scratch copy of the edit buffer (password-masked or copied)

operations.description: Read the font sub-object pointer at this+0xC8; when it is non-zero, read the font path string at sub-object offset 0x40, substituting the shared default byte_5EA438 when that path pointer is null
Apply the resolved font string via sub_498560 so subsequent text measurement uses it
First TextRenderToSurface pass against the reference string unk_5CC218, priming the measurement context and producing an initial width/height pair
Resolve the layout/delegation child object by calling ConditionalDelegation_6460 on this with a zero selector; the result may be null
When the delegation child exists, derive the widget extents: height from the delta between layout quads (v9[3] minus v9[2]) and width from the delta (v9[1] minus *v9)
Fetch the global accessor value v11 from unk_7CDE00 via GlobalAccessor_5150

F_10ParamForwarder forwards the layout request: the child object pointer held at delegation offset 0x20 (v10[8]) dereferenced at +12, the delegation object's origin fields, this+4 and this+12 as widget position, the global accessor, the computed width/height deltas, and two trailing zeros
Initialize the scratch buffer: first byte from byte_5EA438, remaining 252 bytes cleared, and the trailing word/byte fields zeroed; the source edit buffer pointer v12 is read from this+0x2F0

Password-mask branch gated on the byte flag at this+0xE2: walk the source buffer writing '*' (0x2A) into the scratch buffer for each non-null source character, stopping at the null terminator or after 256 characters
Non-mask branch: copy the source edit buffer into the scratch buffer with sub_587DD0, limited to 255 characters
Cursor-glyph branch gated on the visibility flag at this+0xE0 AND the cursor flag at this+0xE1: append the cursor glyph word_5CC214 at the end of the rendered text string (after its null terminator)
Second TextRenderToSurface pass on the (masked/copied, possibly cursor-appended) scratch string, measuring its width into v29 and height into v30

Compute the visible view width as vtable[+32](this) minus vtable[+24](this); while the measured text width v29 exceeds it, advance the render start pointer v17 by one character (left-scroll), re-measure, and bail out once 255 scroll steps are consumed

When the (possibly scrolled) string is non-empty, draw it with BitmapDraw_81f0 at the widget's vtable geometry: left from vtable[+28], top from vtable[+36], width from vtable[+24], height from vtable[+32]
Write the drawn-text geometry into the four out parameters: a2=vtable[+28], a3=vtable[+36], a4=vtable[+24], a5=vtable[+32]
Invoke the post-render update callback at vtable[+44] on this with a zero argument
